show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/6LayAe
show.description: After faking his disappearance from the Chandravamsham army, the legendary archer Arjun lives in disguise as a humble servant to fulfil his dying guru’s last wish , protecting his guru’s daughter and granddaughter. But when greed, betrayal, and deadly warriors threaten to destroy the Gurukul, Arjun must decide whether to remain hidden… or rise again as an unstoppable warrior.
